items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: so they tell me Billy Eckstine came in

ctx.x: And everytime they'd turn around, he'd put one in his mouth and his heart was really -- so they tell me Billy Eckstine came in, had on some ladies' underwear and run and jumped in one guy's lap, say, "Are they all going to be like you?" He says, "I'm going to really have me a ball."
